headline: Chest-high prime-angle SSE with a cross-off morning — the best of the three today.
today: This is the pick of the region today: 3ft at 6.4-7s from the SSE, a prime angle, and WNW cross-off through the morning keeping it clean. Surf the morning around the 11:11 high — shortboard or fish will work fine. SW cross-on softens it up by afternoon, so front-load your day.

daysToWatch.note: Solid day — 4-5ft at a good angle with NNE cross-off at dawn and light ESE by evening. Shortboard fuel, get there early or catch the glassy evening. Worth rearranging plans.
Reading spikes toward 6-7ft but it's 24mph SSW cross-on all day. Blown out — expect a windy mess, not a session.
Still 3ft at a good angle with a light E dawn before it goes onshore. Early window only, then it deteriorates.
